task.title: Reset the NovaGate G200 to factory settings
task.shortdesc: Use a factory reset to restore default settings when you cannot sign in or after a failed update.

taskbody.prereq: Back up your configuration first. A reset erases all settings.

step.cmd: Power on the gateway and wait for the green power LED.
Press and hold the recessed RESET button for 10 seconds.
step.info: Release the button when the LED turns solid blue.

step.cmd: Wait about 2 minutes while the gateway restarts with default settings.

taskbody.result: The gateway is available again at 192.168.1.1 with default settings.
